summary: Comprehensive testing of LZT Vault Phase 2 - Digital Game Account Marketplace with REAL LZT Market API integration. All backend APIs working correctly with real data. Frontend fully functional with category switching, filters, search, pagination, favorites, and product modal.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal close button click may require force=True in Playwright due to animation overlay - works fine in manual testing

backend_passed: API health check returns ok status
/api/market/categories returns 10 categories (riot, steam, fortnite, mihoyo, all, etc.)
/api/market/search/riot returns real Valorant/LoL accounts with items array
MongoDB caching working (consistent data on repeated calls)
Riot accounts have Valorant-specific fields (rank, level, skins, VP, region)
frontend_passed: Dashboard loads with real LZT data (35,776+ accounts)
Navbar renders with logo, nav links, Live API indicator, Sign In button
Category tabs switch between riot/steam/fortnite/mihoyo/all
Product cards display: title, price, rank, level, skins, VP, region badge, origin badge
Search input filters by title
Filter sidebar: price range slider works
Filter sidebar: sort by (newest, price asc/desc) works
Filter sidebar: origin filter works
Filter sidebar: region filter works (Valorant category)
Filter sidebar: currency select works
Reset filters button works
Pagination works (prev/next page buttons) - 895 pages available
Clicking product card opens preview modal
Modal shows: title, price, badges, Buy Now button, View on LZT button
Modal shows stat grid (Rank, Level, VP, Radianite)
Modal shows extra stats (Agents, Knives, Skins)
Modal shows security banner (Recently Active / Account Safe)
Modal Buy Now button links to lzt.market/{item_id}
Modal View on LZT button links correctly
Favorite heart button toggles on cards
Favorites persist in localStorage

critical_code_review_comments: Real LZT Market API integration working correctly via backend proxy
MongoDB caching implemented with TTL (5min search, 15min items)
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Emergent Google OAuth integration ready (Sign In button visible)
Error handling in place for API failures
Price range slider, sort, origin, region, currency filters all functional
test_credentials: No credentials needed - Google OAuth only, favorites stored in localStorage
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - using real LZT Market API data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 complete with real LZT API integration. All 27 features from test plan verified working. Backend proxy endpoints: /api/market/search/{category}, /api/market/item/{item_id}, /api/market/categories, /api/auth/me, /api/auth/logout. Frontend uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements. Modal close button may need force=True in Playwright. Pagination shows 895 pages of results. LZT API token stored in backend/.env as LZT_MARKET_TOKEN.
mocked_api_note: NO MOCKED APIs - All data comes from real LZT Market API (https://prod-api.lzt.market) via backend proxy with MongoDB caching
